reaction: The curled flecks make me curious about what the water carried.

expectation: I expect the cloth to separate some of the residue, though I don't know what it will reveal.

effect: The membrane separated the curled flecks, making their shapes easier to examine.
reaction: The regular projections make me curious, though I can't tell what they mean yet.
reason: The microscope is the only offered combination and should help identify the particles.

effect: The microscope revealed a segmented body with limbs among the residue, and the record was sent to Earth. The chapter does not establish what the body is.
reaction: The limbs and joints surprised me; they made the routine blockage feel much more consequential.

mostWorthwhile.text: Examining the separated flecks under the microscope was most worthwhile: it turned an ordinary maintenance problem into a striking discovery without explaining more than the evidence showed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filtering the residue felt somewhat routine because it was the only offered combination, though separating the flecks had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: I did not expect the residue to contain a body with limbs and a segmented form.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. Each followed naturally from restoring flow, separating the residue, and examining it, although each menu offered only one gameplay action.

continue.text: Yes. I would want to learn what Earth makes of the microscope record and what the body might be.
